summary: Cache persistence failures preserve validated live JMA results, report provenance notes and disable further caching for that command.
reason: A full or unwritable optional cache must not discard an otherwise valid live forecast or warning; failed cleanup must not grow the cache.
validated_outcome: Synthetic write/cleanup regression tests passed; publish-time live acceptance regenerated. Verification scripts use the Makefile binary directory and packaged linker flags use the canonical module path.
